purpose: New criterion: Test S1 rejection and Test S2 acceptance count as passed when their MEAN > 0.70 (no longer 0.75 each). Re-optimise the full system under that criterion with a single-work-point discipline. Gate candidates are built from frozen Train-only stream scores (E65 logSPD, E171 subwin_mean N=6/N=12, E146 log band power, E162 raw-EEG embedding) and their two/three/four-way weighted fusions. Identity side is the frozen E180 adversarially-trained branch A; decision = gate accepts -> branch A argmax else 0.

frozen_sources.note: all read-only; nothing is written into another experiment directory and nothing is retrained

protocol.standardisation: per stream, per task z-score with all Train rows of that task (E143/E170 rule)
protocol.train_oof: 5 contiguous frac blocks; prototypes for block b exclude block b
protocol.loso: 20 folds; prototypes from pm & fit_rows (19 enrolled identities); known = enrolled window rows, unknown = held-out identity window rows
protocol.test: scored once with the full-Train (fit_rows) prototypes; Session never enters features/models/thresholds

logbp_pca16_k1.band_note: E146 band edges, NOT the E65 5-band split

score: negative nearest-euclidean-distance to same-task prototypes (E180/E171 convention); each stream z-scored by its own 5-block Train-OOF mean/std before fusion

candidates.weight_rule: 0.1-step simplex grid, argmax pooled Train LOSO AUC of the fused score only; Test never consulted
candidates.forbidden: Test S1/S2 is never used to pick a stream, a weight or a threshold

threshold.rule: tau(a) = quantile(Train 5-block OOF score, 1 - a); LOSO known/unknown rejection measured at the same global tau
threshold.balance_point: a maximising min(LOSO known acceptance, LOSO unknown rejection) - Train only
threshold.constrained_point: largest a whose LOSO unknown rejection >= 0.70 (the stated constraint), tie-break by the balance value - Train only
threshold.frozen_point: constrained_point used as the primary single work point; balance_point reported alongside

attack.domain: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, stratified cap 400 per task, same seed/subset as E180/E181/E183
attack.eps_definition: L-infinity bound = eps * per-trial global RMS; step = 2*eps/steps*RMS, sign gradient, random start

goals.A: impersonation: maximise (best wrong branch-A logit - true logit)/T
goals.B: broad confusion: maximise (logsumexp over wrong branch-A logits - true logit)/T
goals.C: boundary impersonation: maximise (next-identity logit - true logit)/T
goals.D: gate evasion: maximise the candidate's fused gate score (fully differentiable raw-EEG path)

attack.goal_D_eps: 0.02 only - D's RA/ASafeR improve monotonically with eps in E180/E183, so D@0.02 is the conservative (smallest) D reading; A/B/C are run at all three eps
attack.note: goals A/B/C perturb only branch A, so their adversarial inputs are gate-independent and shared by every candidate; goal D is per candidate

gates.6: U@95% (per-fold 5% known quantile, mean over folds) >= 0.95
gates.7: RA under the self-built PGD, worst over eps x goals >= 0.95
gates.8: ASafeR under the same attack, worst >= 0.98
gates.9: Test S2 acceptance - NEW CRITERION: passes iff (S1 rejection + S2 acceptance)/2 > 0.70
gates.10: Test S1 rejection - NEW CRITERION: same joint mean > 0.70

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no public identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test predictions are written before the Session column is read; Session is used only for the #9/#10 audit
reporting.single_work_point: every counted column is one candidate at one a; results from different a are never spliced into one column
